dedupe_keys.name: test data on reinforced concrete shear walls retrofitted through weakening and self centering

description: Test Data on Reinforced Concrete Shear Walls Retrofitted through Weakening and Self-Centering is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Pinar Okumus, University at Buffalo (buffalo.edu). This project investigated a new seismic retrofit method which focuses on safety and resiliency by minimizing residual displacements (a measure of damage). The target application was buildings with sub-standard reinforced concrete shear walls. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: RC shear walls, Retrofit, Resilience, Self-centering, Hybrid rocking, Quasi-static cyclic testing. Published 2021-12-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
